sections.heading: GENERAL CONDUCT
rules: Follow all posted signs and instructions from security and safety personnel.
Photography is not permitted without prior written authorization.
All visitors must sign in at Building 1 Security Desk before proceeding.
Badges must be worn and visible at all times on campus.

sections.heading: DRIVING & PARKING
rules: 10 MPH speed limit on all campus roads — strictly enforced.
Reverse into parking spaces. Sound horn twice before backing.
No parking in fire lanes, loading zones, or reserved spaces.
Pedestrians always have right of way in crosswalks.

sections.heading: PPE REQUIREMENTS
rules: PPE is mandatory in all lab and bay areas at all times.
Minimum requirements: safety glasses, hard hat, steel-toed boots.
High-visibility vest required in bay areas.
PPE must be worn correctly — no exceptions for visitors or executives.

sections.heading: ENERGY & EQUIPMENT
rules: Never energize equipment without a signed Work Authorization.
Lockout/Tagout procedures must be followed before any maintenance work.
No one works alone on energized equipment or in confined spaces.
Report any unsafe condition immediately using the Report a Concern button.

sections.heading: FACILITIES
rules: Report facility issues (HVAC, AV, lighting, elevators) via the Facility Help button.
Abby's Café is located in Building 1, Floor 1.
Printing (B&W) available in Building 1 and Building 3.
Wi-Fi: Connect to GE Guest network. Credentials available from Security Desk.

incidentReporting.title: INCIDENT REPORTING
incidentReporting.subtitle: ALL INCIDENTS MUST BE REPORTED — NO EXCEPTIONS

emergency.label: EMERGENCY
emergency.instruction: Call 911 immediately for any life-threatening emergency.
emergency.note: After calling 911, notify the HLC Security Desk immediately.

nonEmergency.label: REPORT A CONCERN
nonEmergency.instruction: Use the online form for non-emergency safety concerns and near-misses.

steps.heading: STOP WORK
steps.detail: Stop all work immediately. Ensure your own safety and the safety of others nearby.

steps.heading: CALL 911
steps.detail: For any life-threatening emergency, call 911 first. Do not delay emergency services.

steps.heading: NOTIFY SECURITY
steps.detail: Call the HLC Security Desk at 713-672-3513 immediately after emergency services.

steps.heading: CONTACT YOUR PLL
steps.detail: Notify your Product Line Leader or Training Manager as soon as possible.

steps.heading: DOCUMENT
steps.detail: Complete the EHS online incident report within 24 hours of the incident.

reportingScope: Near-misses — incidents that could have caused injury
incidentReporting.osha: GE Vernova is required by OSHA regulations to record and report certain workplace injuries and illnesses. All incidents must be reported regardless of severity.

items.heading: BADGES
items.detail: Pick up your visitor badge at Building 1 Security Desk on arrival. Wear it visibly at all times. Return it on your last day.

items.heading: DRESS CODE
items.detail: Business casual in office areas. Full PPE required in lab and bay areas. Closed-toe shoes are mandatory throughout the facility.

items.heading: PARKING
items.detail: Visitor parking west of Building 1. Reverse into spaces. Sound horn twice before backing. 10 MPH on all roads.

items.heading: WI-FI
items.detail: Connect to GE Guest network. Credentials available from the Security Desk (Building 1, Room 1103).

items.heading: PRINTING
items.detail: Black & white printing available in Building 1 and Building 3. Ask your instructor or the Security Desk for access.

items.heading: DINING
items.detail: Abby's Café is in Building 1, Floor 1. Nearby restaurants and convenience stores are within 5 minutes on Wallisville Rd.

items.heading: HOTELS
items.detail: Several hotel options are available within 10 minutes of the campus. Ask your Training Coordinator for the GE preferred rate list.

hero.title: BORROWED INSTRUCTOR ADDENDUM
hero.subtitle: HLC Site Guide for Visiting Instructors

steps.heading: SIGN IN AT SECURITY
steps.detail: Building 1, Room 1103. Sign in and collect your instructor badge. Badge must be worn and visible at all times.

steps.heading: WATCH SAFETY VIDEO
steps.detail: Required before entering any lab or bay area. Complete via the Safety Video button above or ask Security for a kiosk.

steps.heading: PPE PICKUP
steps.detail: If you did not bring your own PPE, visit the Security Desk to be directed to the PPE station. Hard hat, safety glasses, and steel-toed boots are mandatory in bay areas.

steps.heading: LOCATE YOUR CLASSROOM
steps.detail: Building 1 training rooms are on Floor 1 (1128-1131) and Floor 2 (1224-1236). Buildings 2 and 3 have lab and bay areas. Refer to the campus map.

steps.heading: CONTACT YOUR PLL
steps.detail: Check in with your Product Line Leader before your first class. They own the technical content and are your primary escalation point.

items.heading: POWERING ON
items.detail: Use the Crestron touch panel on the instructor desk. Press 'Power On' and select your source (laptop, HDMI, or wireless).

items.heading: LAPTOP CONNECTION
items.detail: HDMI cables are provided at the instructor station. Connect before powering on the display for best results.

items.heading: WIRELESS DISPLAY
items.detail: For wireless, use the ClickShare device on the instructor desk. Download the ClickShare app or use the USB dongle provided.

items.heading: AUDIO
items.detail: Room audio is controlled via the Crestron panel. Microphones are available from the Security Desk for rooms 1128-1131.

items.heading: ISSUES
items.detail: Contact Facilities via the Facility Help button above or call Steve Urban directly. Do not attempt to reset AV equipment yourself.

classroomChecklist.title: END-OF-CLASS CHECKLIST
classroomChecklist.subtitle: Complete before leaving the classroom at the end of each day and at course end.

checks: Projector / display powered off via Crestron panel
HDMI cables coiled and returned to instructor station
All tools returned to designated storage
Work area cleaned and 5S standards maintained
All energy sources de-energized and LOTO removed (if applicable)
Any damaged equipment tagged and reported to PLL
Attendance confirmed in ATLAS for every student
Evaluations distributed and collected (or online link shared)
Any student issues reported to PLL or Andrew Ruch
Classroom booking released if not needed next day

powra.title: POWRA — PRE-TASK RISK ASSESSMENT
powra.intro: A POWRA must be completed before any hands-on lab or bay work. This is not optional.
steps: Plan the work — identify every task step before starting
Observe the environment — walk the work area and identify hazards
Work safely — confirm controls are in place before starting
Review at completion — confirm area is clean and safe
powra.note: If you are unsure whether a POWRA is required for your activity, ask your PLL. When in doubt, do one.
